trial_court: Family Court, Matrimonial Case no. 114 of 2008
case_name: Gunjan Kumari vs Vinay Kumar Pandey

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: GUNJAN KUMARI, D/O LATE AWADHESH KUMAR THAKUR, WIFE OF SRI VINAY KUMAR PANDEY @ PAPPU
parties.respondent_defendant: VINAY KUMAR PANDEY SON OF SRI RAM KRIPAL PANDEY

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks interim maintenance till disposal of the case.

legal_principles.principle: An appeal shall lie from every judgment or order, not being an interlocutory order, of a Family Court to the High Court both on facts and on law.
legal_principles.held: It would be manifest from Sub-section (1) of Section 19 that the Appeals are available against judgment and order, not being Interlocutory Order of a Family Court, to the High Court, both on facts and law.

legal_principles.principle: No appeal or revision shall lie to any Court from any judgment, order or decree of a Family Court except as provided in Section 19 of the Act itself.
legal_principles.held: There is specific bar under Section 19(5) of the Act to the effect that no appeal or revision shall lie to any Court from any judgment or order or decree of a Family Court except that has been provided in Section 19 of the Act itself.

legal_principles.principle: Orders passed under Chapter IX of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 are appealable if they are not interlocutory in nature.
legal_principles.held: That apart, section 28(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act provides that even the orders passed under Sections 25 and 26 are appealable if they are not interlocutory in nature.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order granting interim maintenance was upheld.
